requirements.requirement: Point at an App table record or field and ask the Agent to update it
requirements.acceptance: A selected visible field retains its column ID and record ID through the annotation draft, opens the exact ACL-protected record conversation, and includes the record snapshot and field identity in the Agent context. Persist the message and annotation only to that record; verify another record and unauthorized viewers cannot read it. Agent-proposed changes must require explicit confirmation, current edit ACL, schema validation and row CAS; Undo is allowed only while the row remains at the applied version. Authenticated production comparison remains required. Preserve the existing Simple mode and use no new paid service.

evidence.verified: The table drag-selection now carries visible column ID and row/table identity into the record conversation. Worker allows annotation only after appConversation validates that exact linked table/record under the viewer's current ACL. Record-scoped AI returns a bounded proposal; only an edit-authorized member can explicitly apply it through strict updateRow validation and expectedUpdatedAt CAS. Rejection does not write; stale proposals fail closed; undo is limited to the exact applied row version and rechecks permission. Worker regressions cover proposal/apply/undo/stale conflict; Web covers the confirmation card. The focused Worker conversation suite passed 119 tests and the implementation is included in main CI run 42494741384 and Worker deployment run 42494741296, including D1 migrations and Verify.
evidence.remaining: The full Worker suite did not finish locally because unrelated network-dependent tests lost connectivity. Authenticated production record/field interaction and side-by-side Kylon comparison remain. This remains partial parity until those acceptance checks are completed.

requirements.requirement: Per-run human approval for an Agent wake with bounded scope
requirements.acceptance: When an Agent requests a handoff to a room Agent without a static peer grant, persist one pending approval bound to the exact assignment generation, source/target Agent, room, thread, source message and operation. Create a private decision card and do not write a handoff message, create a dispatch outbox row, claim, or call the target before approval. Authorized human decisions grant one of: once, ten minutes (default), exact thread, exact room. Store expiry, use limit/count and exact room/thread bindings server-side; never trust scope from mutable card metadata. Revalidate current approver ACL, source and target availability/room access, request state, expiry and exact binding at decision and dispatch. Duplicate requests, decline, cancellation, expiration, simultaneous consumption and replay must fail closed. The grant creator can list and revoke their own grants; expired and consumed once grants remain distinguishable in history. Preserve Simple mode and add no paid service.

evidence.verified: Kylon changelog dated 2026-10-30 describes Allow once, Allow for 10 min (default), Allow in this thread, and Always allow in this room. Honmaru implements private pending decision cards; no target dispatch before approval; server-stored once/10-minute/thread/room scopes; current assignment, membership and room checks at decision and dispatch; creator grant listing/revocation; expiry, cancellation, duplicate, replay and race handling. Focused agent-wake-approvals tests and dispatch revalidation landed in PRs #823 and #826. Exact-head CI for #826 (42493079407), post-merge main CI (42494741384) and Worker deployment (42494741296) succeeded; deployment ran migrations, Deploy and Verify.
evidence.remaining: Status stays partial pending authenticated production approval flow acceptance, full multi-actor race/replay verification on the live service, and side-by-side Kylon interaction comparison. A successful build/deploy alone is not parity acceptance. Simple mode remains unchanged; no paid service was added.

requirements.requirement: Interactive charts and explainer pages inside Agent messages
requirements.acceptance: Harness Agents may emit a bounded honmaru-visual JSON block for bar/line charts or explainer sections. Render charts with native accessible SVG plus a data-table view and selectable series; render explainer navigation using text-only rich rendering. Reject malformed/oversized schemas and leave them visible as literal code. Never evaluate HTML, script or arbitrary code. Verify responsive light/dark display, persisted message replay, and authenticated side-by-side Kylon behavior. Preserve Simple unchanged and add no paid dependency.

Agent preparation explains the supported schema and safety boundary. Simple messages continue through the existing rich text renderer. requirements.requirement: Long-running Agent tasks compact context and continue
requirements.acceptance: When a Responses or OpenRouter chat-tool chain grows large, checkpoint the original task, bounded recent context, completed tool calls and their results; begin a fresh chain and continue without repeating completed side effects. Maintain the same authorization check, cancellation, source collection, 16-call and 240-second execution limits, and cap compactions. Continue after eight model rounds up to the hard round limit. Use only the existing provider and record normal token usage; do not add a separate summarizer service. Verify small-context behavior, compaction and duplicate-call suppression, authorization revocation, cancellation, and authenticated long-task UX. Preserve Simple mode.

evidence.verified: Kylon's 2026-10-30 changelog states that long Agent tasks condense context and keep going. The OpenAI Responses and OpenRouter chat-tool paths compact locally from bounded original input, completed tool-call/result ledger and latest progress when provider-reported input reaches 48,000 tokens or accumulated tool results exceed the same estimated context budget; each starts a fresh model chain and suppresses exact repeated calls after checkpoint. Both allow up to two checkpoints and 16 total model rounds while retaining 16 tool calls, authorization, cancellation and existing per-execution deadlines. On reaching the checkpoint cap they stop running tools and request a final answer from saved evidence. No extra summarizer request or vendor is introduced. Consolidated Worker tests pass: 149 tests across agent-chat-tools, agent-research, handoff, agents and Harness agents, including continuation beyond eight rounds, checkpoint content, large tool-result growth, duplicate suppression, cap behavior, authorization and cancellation regressions.
evidence.release: OpenRouter/BYO chat-tool extension merged in PR #866 as eb192283b8df2c371106d5e887d169833c008506. Exact-head CI #42717933744, main CI #42720363920, and Worker deployment #42720363385 passed; production Worker /health returned ok:true and app.honmaruai.com returned HTTP 200.
evidence.remaining: Authenticated production long-task acceptance for both provider paths remains. Runs are bounded by the caller deadline and existing tool-call budget; this is partial parity rather than unlimited execution.

requirements.requirement: Private parallel sub-agents for bounded research
requirements.acceptance: A Harness Agent may delegate up to two independent private subtasks to parallel copies of itself. Each helper receives bounded context, the parent Agent’s current scoped read-only team/memory/skill/thread tools, a 30-second deadline, at most four model rounds and three tool calls, and returns only a bounded final finding. Helpers cannot browse, execute code, write or publish records, message people, approve, change grants, or delegate again. Parent authorization, cancellation, deadline and usage accounting remain in force. Preserve Simple mode and add no service or separate charge.

evidence.verified: Implemented a Harness-only delegate_subagents tool for OpenRouter chat-tools and OpenAI Responses. Helpers run in parallel, are limited to two, use an explicit read-only allowlist, have bounded task/context/results and per-helper budgets, recheck parent authorization, and discard results if authorization is revoked. Simple calls do not receive the tool.
evidence.remaining: Authenticated production exercise and side-by-side Kylon verification remain. Kylon routing choices, durable helper run cards/history, independent helper identities/credentials and longer-running cloud execution are not implemented; this is partial parity.

requirements.requirement: Data Viewerの現在の結果をCSVまたはExcelで書き出す
requirements.acceptance: 現在のビューのfilter・search・group順と表示列を保ったCSVまたはXLSXを端末内で生成する。Relation列は表示名、system列は有効な場合だけ出力し、引用・改行・Unicode・数式注入を安全に扱い、5,000件まで出力する。Simple modeを維持し新規課金を追加しない。

evidence.verified: Data Viewerのその他メニューにCSV/XLSX書き出しを追加。両形式で同じフィルター済みビュー・検索結果・グループ順・表示列・Relation表示名を利用。CSVはRFC形式の引用、式無害化、Excel向けUTF-8 BOMに対応。XLSXはローカルOOXML生成でセル値を文字列として扱い、式実行を防ぐ。空の結果と最大5,000件（既存App表示上限）を対象とする。
evidence.remaining: この差分のPR CI・本番反映後の認証画面でのダウンロード確認、モバイルと5,000件超のUX、Kylonとの詳細な出力比較が残る。部分一致として扱う。

requirements.requirement: 個人の音声入力辞書と修正学習
requirements.acceptance: 利用者が音声入力の語句を追加・削除でき、入力後の修正から語句訂正を学習する。辞書はworkspaceの他メンバーへ漏らさず、同一アカウントの端末間でrevision付き同期を行う。認識途中のテキストをComposerに反映し、利用者が送信した後の遅延認識で送信済み文章を再変更しない。Simple modeと既存のAI/音声契約を維持し、新規課金・認識内容の追加保存を行わない。Web/Mac両方でログイン済みKylonと比較する。

evidence.verified: Kylonの2026-11-03 changelogは人ごとのdictation dictionary、修正または手動登録による語彙学習、認識完了前の送信を追加。Honmaru Harnessは手動語彙・修正ペア、利用者単位の保存、revision CASの同期、途中結果のComposer反映と送信後の停止を実装している。
evidence.remaining: 現在のリポジトリでのコンポーネント/Worker回帰試験結果を最新headに固定し、認証済みMac/Web双方で辞書編集・修正学習・端末同期・認識中送信をKylonと比較する。認識途中の実Provider動作はブラウザ実装に依存するため受入確認が必要。

requirements.requirement: Grok Botデスクトップアプリを既存契約のままチームAgentとして接続
requirements.acceptance: Grok Bot desktop appの既存routine/webhookを使ってworkspaceのAgentとして接続し、チームメンバーがスレッドから依頼・追記し、完了結果と進捗を元スレッドへ返せる。受付(HTTP 200)を完了と誤認せず、重複実行・取消・失効・権限変更を安全に扱い、Bot所有者の既存利用枠を明示する。外部送信前に接続内容を確認し、Simpleモードの既存経路を維持する。

evidence.verified: Kylon公式changelogはGrok Bot desktop appをworkspace teammateへ接続する経路を説明。xAI公式routine docsはWebhookを入力トリガーとして説明し、HTTP 200が受付であって完了ではないことを明記。xAI公式computer/apps docsはGrok BotのRemote HTTPS custom MCP connectorを説明。Honmaruは既存routine webhook、暗号化保存、ワンタイムtoken、元threadへの結果配信、取消/期限処理を実装。現在の作業ブランチではMCP Streamable HTTP completion toolを追加し、ローカルWorker統合試験で初期化・tool discovery・誤token拒否・一回性・thread応答を確認。
evidence.remaining: MCP completion bridgeはPR/本番未反映。Grok Bot実画面でRemote HTTPS connectorの登録とroutineからのtool呼び出しを未確認で、実アカウントでの外部実行・進捗・Kylon UI/操作比較も未確認。Webhookキー・URL設定から完了MCP登録までのユーザー導線を実画面で検証し、実際のGrok Bot互換性を確認する。
